scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in yarn/*) ;; *) echo "Use yarn instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: yarn typecheck && yarn workspace @workspace/pharmacy-ops run build && yarn workspace @workspace/mockup-sandbox run build && yarn workspace @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: yarn typecheck:libs && yarn workspace @workspace/pharmacy-ops run typecheck && yarn workspace @workspace/mockup-sandbox run typecheck && yarn workspace @workspace/api-server run typecheck && yarn workspace @workspace/scripts run typecheck
